title: Illegal Spray Painting
description: Use this service request to report illegal spray painting by commercial businesses that are not using the proper painting booth, causing vapors to go into the neighborhood where applying flammable or combustible coatings onto products is an integral part of their work process without benefit of an approved spray booth, spray room, or spray area. Do not use for individual spray painting, reporting graffiti or tagging. The estimated response time for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.question: Please describe the illegal spray painting being done by the company/business:
What is the occupancy location type?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for a commercial business applying flammable or combustible coatings as part of its work without an approved spray booth, spray room, or spray area, when vapors enter the neighborhood.
actions.why: For a commercial business applying flammable or combustible coatings as part of its work without an approved spray booth, spray room, or spray area, when vapors enter the neighborhood. The request asks for a description of the business activity and occupancy type.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Illegal Spray Painting" requests does not apply to individual spray painting, graffiti, or tagging.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Illegal Spray Painting"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Non-Emergency Police and Fire Services" > Choose "Illegal Spray Painting"
